visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two women are standing back-to-back in a bright white studio environment. The woman on the left has short black hair and wears a white ruffled strapless wedding dress, while the woman on the right has long wavy brown hair and wears a heavily sequined, sparkly wedding dress with floral sleeve accents. They maintain neutral yet pleasant facial expressions as they lean against each other. (2) The camera angle changes to show a hand entering from the right foreground holding a smartphone, capturing a photo of the two women. They are now holding hands and looking directly into the lens, smiling. A lighting tripod is partially visible in the minimalist white background. (3) The women are sitting on the white floor with their voluminous dress skirts spread out around them. A photographer's shoulder is visible in the foreground as the women lean their heads together, smiling warmly in a candid pose. (4) Sitting closely, the women look down at the screen of a professional DSLR camera held by the woman on the right. They appear to be reviewing the photographs, with the woman on the left touching her chest area as they smile and interact. (5) In a high-angle overhead shot, the two women look up towards the camera. The woman on the right leans in and kisses the cheek of the woman on the left. Both are laughing and smiling brightly, holding the DSLR camera between them.
